source_name: INEC Continuous Voter Registration Portal — Polling Unit Locator (PublicApi)
retrieval_method: Live, unauthenticated fetch() from an active browser session on the official INEC domain, captured via network-request inspection of cvr.inecnigeria.org/pu's own cascading State/LGA/Ward/Polling-Unit locator form.
reference_cycle: Not explicitly labelled by INEC on this page as a specific election year. This reflects the CURRENT live configuration served by INEC's Continuous Voter Registration system as of the retrieval date — the same data INEC's own public Polling Unit Locator serves to real voters today. Treated as the current/live cycle, not asserted as '2023' or '2027' specifically, since INEC's own interface does not state a cycle label.

pollingUnitSample.note: One ward's full polling-unit list, captured to confirm PU-level shape/naming convention. NOT a complete PU census — see inec-delta-reconciliation-live.json for state-wide PU COUNTS only.
